text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Today too, I'll ganbaru and aim to become
a wonderful horse girl like Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? That girl...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah! So cute.
She's wearing horse girl ears and a tail~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: A... Aaaaah~! It's Spe-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Real? You're the real one, right?
Yaaay~! The real Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh, eh? Y-You are...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A-Are you... a fan of mine?!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I saw you running before
at the community center festival!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The community center... Ah! I think I went there
as part of some volunteer work!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~.
Spe-chan, you were so cool back then~.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I grow up,
I wanna be just like Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! B-But back then, I was...
um, really uncool, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was so nervous that I tripped hard and fell,
getting completely covered in mud and all...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Uh-uh! But then you jumped right back up
and went zooming straight ahead, whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
It was like magic, so amazing!
Spe-chan was the coolest of all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No way... I-I'm really not the kind of
horse girl who deserves praise like that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
L-Look! Do you know Suzuka-san?
Silence Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's the horse girl who took 1st place back then.
Her running is so beautiful and she's super cool!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to look up to someone,
a horse girl like Suzuka-san would be...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh... But I
can't run like that at all.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
But trying my hardest like Spe-chan,
that's something I can do!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be like Spe-chan, someone who
never gives up even when things are tough!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Never gives up on anything... Just like me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a break in the central plaza between training sessions,
Silence Suzuka and Special Week came into view.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Suzuka-san, please listen!
Um, just a moment ago...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see, that happened... Spe-chan,
that girl had sparkling eyes, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! She really did.
How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Because I figured it was the same look you have
whenever you talk about me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...There are surely things that only someone like you,
Spe-chan, could inspire in that child.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Things that only I could inspire... I never even
dreamed that I had something like that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm glad you were able to realize
what makes you special, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Suzuka-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really admire you, Suzuka-san.
I want to become just like you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, though,
I realized I need to treasure "myself" just as much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take what I admire from you
and aim to become a brand-new Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose the "me"
that little girl looks up to, desu!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Well then,
what are you going to adopt first?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe staying cool and composed!
Being calm is really important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of which... I heard they're serving
carrot hamburg steak for dinner today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!? Then I gotta hurry—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Calmly and quickly take a shower.
See you in a bit, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Honest with yourself, and able to rejoice
with everything you've got when something good happens...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That Spe-chan is someone
I really admire too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka quietly watched Special Week leave,
never giving up on her strive toward what she admired.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Oh no,
if I don't hurry, they might run out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aah, but I'm all sweaty,
so I have to take a shower first...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No, should I just go as I am...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But but, then I won't be like Suzuka-san...
A-anyway, I just gotta hurry!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Suzuka-san!
I'm gonna go take a showeeer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Full of energy,
even right after training.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because Spe-chan is like that
that everyone around her gets pulled along and cheered up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka watched with a smile as Special Week rushed off,
always earnest and straightforward.
